subject: Acceptance criteria & rate reconciliation for CoastalHealth change order
messages:
From: Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@coastalhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@coastalhealth.com>, Legal Team <contracts@coastalhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: CoastalHealth change order — acceptance criteria & rate recon

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement team is moving ahead with the proposed capacity uplift but legal has pushed back on two items before we can sign:

1) Clear acceptance criteria for the phased implementation (we need a short test matrix and success thresholds for each milestone).
2) A reconciliation table showing how the new rates map back to the existing Order Form so our billing system can ingest changes without manual work.

I've attached the change order draft (CoastalHealth_ChangeOrder_v1.pdf). Can you share a proposed acceptance checklist and a reconciled fee table? Also, our legal contact (cc'd) will want to review any MSA amendment language for rollback/credits.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we are targeting a July 25 sign date from our side.

-Mark

Attachment: CoastalHealth_ChangeOrder_v1.pdf (pdf, 185KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@coastalhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@coastalhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CoastalHealth change order — acceptance criteria & rate recon

Thanks Mark — looping in Karthik and Laura to scope the deliverables. Quick plan:

- Karthik: can you produce a reconciled fee table that maps the existing order form lines to the proposed uplift (showing per-token / per-embedding effective rates and monthly committed GPU hours)? Prefer an XLSX with a short "diff" sheet.
- Laura: please prepare the DocuSign envelope sequence and confirm signatories (we'll need procurement + legal).
- I'll draft a concise acceptance criteria doc (one page) that includes milestone tests, KPIs for latency/cost, and rollback triggers.

Proposed acceptance checklist (high level):
- Milestone 1 (Provisioning): dedicated pool visible in console, baseline latency <= 120ms (p99) for 2k seq tests.
- Milestone 2 (Functional): sample traffic run with prefix cache enabled, end-to-end request/response validation against test prompts (95% match on golden set).
- Milestone 3 (Scale): sustained throughput at committed level for 4 hours with no degraded error rate >0.5%.

Karthik/Laura — can you have the fee table and DocuSign plan by EOD Tuesday? I'll send the acceptance draft then.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@coastalhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@coastalhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CoastalHealth change order — fee table proposal

Attaching a reconciled fee table (fee-table-proposal.xlsx). Highlights:

- Converted committed GPU hours into an effective per-token rate using CoastalHealth's reported token mix.
- Added a "legacy mapping" tab that shows how current invoice line items map to the new SKU breakdown.
- Flagged two imprecisions where CoastalHealth had a bundled discount applied; we propose preserving the net $ but changing line presentation to match our standard orderform structure.

Open questions for legal:
- If we add a rollback credit, should it be capped at X months of committed fees or tied to a measured performance delta?

I can iterate tomorrow after legal's guidance.

Attachment: fee-table-proposal.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

-Karthik

From: Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@coastalhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@coastalhealth.com>, Legal Team <contracts@coastalhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jul 2028 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CoastalHealth change order — fee table proposal

On Tue, Jul 16, 2028 at 09:22 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attaching a reconciled fee table (fee-table-proposal.xlsx). Highlights:
> ...

Thanks Karthik — that looks mostly good. Two clarifications from legal:

- Rollback credit: we'd prefer a performance-linked credit (e.g., measured p99 latency vs. agreed baseline) capped at 3 months consumption rather than a fixed-dollar cap.
- Acceptance tests: can Redwood provide the test harness or will CoastalHealth run against a provided test plan? We prefer Redwood-run tests for the Tier 1 gating so results are consistent.

We'll sign off on the fee mapping if those two items are addressed and we have the final MSA amendment language for rollback/credits.

-Mark

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Mark Daniels <mark.daniels@coastalhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@coastalhealth.com>, Legal Team <contracts@coastalhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CoastalHealth change order — acceptance criteria & next steps

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps below.

Summary of agreements to date:
- Fee reconciliation: Redwood provided a fee-table mapping; CoastalHealth legal is ok to preserve net $; Karthik to submit final XLSX with the "legacy mapping" tab removed for the orderform ingest.
- Acceptance tests: Redwood will run Tier 1 acceptance tests (Grace to coordinate test window and provide harness).
- Rollback credit: proposed language will tie credits to measured p99 latency breach vs. the agreed baseline and cap the payout at 3 months of average committed spend (we'll draft formal amendment language for legal review).

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Karthik: finalize fee table (remove internal mapping) and return final XLSX — ETA: Fri 7/19 EOD.
- Grace: deliver acceptance_criteria-draft.md and test harness instructions for Redwood-run tests — ETA: Fri 7/19 EOD.
- Laura: prepare DocuSign envelope with Procurement + CoastalHealth Legal as signatories; include MSA amendment placeholder — ETA: Mon 7/22.
- CoastalHealth Legal: review draft amendment language for the rollback credit — target feedback by Tue 7/23.

I'll attach the acceptance draft to the DocuSign envelope once finalized. If we stay on this timeline, we should be able to hit Mark's target sign date of July 25.

Thanks — appreciate the fast coordination.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0187
redwood.com
